From: Elixir Parity. User-approved 2026-11-24.

Evidence: /Users/j5n/Workspace/fz-otp-json/probes/mue28/reraise.exs. When a reason is re-raised with :erlang.raise(kind, reason, __STACKTRACE__), Elixir rebuilds FunctionClauseError's module/function/arity and KeyError's term from the stacktrace. fz carries no stacktrace, so those fields come back unset.

Blocked on fz-mue.65 (stacktraces).

Done when: the probe's cases run as an oracle fixture and match Elixir on interp, run and build.
title: A reason re-raised with :erlang.raise(kind, reason, __STACKTRACE__) keeps the fields Elixir restores
